product: Korean-language GBC port of the original NES Final Fantasy III
deliverable: Offline distribution package that accepts a user-supplied supported NES ROM, validates it, extracts and converts source data, compiles the source-equivalent GBC implementation, links assets and Korean text, and emits a GBC ROM plus a build report
sourceAuthority: Pinned user ROM bytes and observed original behavior; annotated disassembly and editor definitions are cross-checked references
gameplayPolicy: Preserve original game state, integer widths, formulas, RNG semantics, item/equipment/magic/job rules, event scripts, progression and menu interactions; do not invent substitute gameplay or prose
presentationPolicy: Use approved GBC viewport, party/enemy pixel-size rules and Hangul font as rendering constraints; preserve original information, interaction order, message meaning and timing dependencies
prototypeStatus: Frozen feasibility evidence only. Existing combat-model.c, authored dialogue, status/reward screens and fixed sample party names are not production gameplay or localization inputs
nextImplementation: Source audio interpreter and GBC output feasibility check, through the ROM-input build path; no further invented gameplay samples
runtimeArchitecture: Source-corresponding native GBC logic plus converted ROM data; no claim of an existing fully automatic 6502-to-SM83 compiler
releaseInputs: Port implementation, versioned extraction/conversion rules, source-linked Korean translation records, permitted font/toolchain dependencies; original ROM and generated original-game asset files are supplied or generated locally
releaseChecks: clean offline build from supported ROM
